title: Read-only delegate primitive rather than a new engine role
summary: Meta-work (inventory, classification, cross-referencing) needs one read-only call with a checkable output, not worktrees/review/integration. `agent-os orchestrate delegate` reuses router.select and the provider adapters, validates an output contract, and records a capability observation. Adding an analyst role to engine.py was rejected as higher-risk for no extra benefit.
